messages:
anya: hi payroll/people ops 1  I worked from CA for three months (Jan-Mar 2025) while still officially CO-based. my June paystub shows CA state withholding for all of 2025 YTD. i thought we only withhold CA for days physically worked there. did i miss a form?

mike (People Ops): hey @anya  thanks for calling this out. we have a split-residency policy, but payroll needs the travel logs to allocate wages by work location. did you submit the temporary-work form or the travel calendar?

anya: i filled the travel calendar on 2025-03-05 (and attached itineraries), but never got a confirmation. paycheck excerpt: "State: CALIFORNIA - YTD State Withheld: $1,840" which seems high for 3 months.

dan (Payroll): checking your record now. common issue: if the tax-state field was set to CA when the payroll file exported, it'll apply CA withholding to all YTD wages. we rely on the travel calendar export to set location-based withholding. i don't see the travel calendar flag on your payroll record. can you re-upload the itinerary to PAY-3567?

rachel (Tax Counsel): tax note: California taxes nonresidents on CA-sourced wages (work performed physically in CA) even if you're a CO resident. If withholding happened for the whole year, we can correct the allocation and run a supplemental to refund the overstated CA withholding and adjust CO withholding accordingly. But we need your day-by-day work log to substantiate non-CA wages. For filing, you'll likely file a CA nonresident return (Form 540NR) and claim credit on CO return if double taxed.

anya: re-uploaded travel calendar and attached flight/hotel confirmations to PAY-3567. thanks for the next steps.

dan (Payroll): got it. PAY-3567 queued for audit. action: 1) reconcile day-by-day allocation for Jan-Mar 2025; 2) if CA was withheld in error for Apr-Jun, run supplemental refund for the excess CA withholding and add CO withholding where appropriate; 3) flag for end-of-year W-2 allocation to ensure state boxes reflect corrected residency split. ETA: 5 business days. tagging @payroll-bot.

payroll-bot: PAY-3567 audit scheduled  assigned to dan  expected completion: 2025-07-10. :gear:

mike (People Ops): we'll also add a checklist reminder to confirm travel logs are acknowledged by payroll after submission. apologies for the hassle, @anya.

anya: appreciate it  i'll keep receipts until everything is sorted and set aside funds in case there's any tax due. thanks team!
